mapper.select: SELECT validation_run_id AS validationRunId, validation_month AS validationMonth, run_no AS runNo, run_type AS runType, status, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, finalized_at AS finalizedAt, triggered_by AS triggeredBy, finalized_by AS finalizedBy, failure_message AS failureMessage, created_at AS createdAt FROM fgc.validation_run WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fgc.validation_run WHERE validation_month = #{validationMonth} AND run_type = 'MONTHLY' AND status IN ('CREATED', 'RUNNING') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fgc.validation_run (validation_month, run_no, run_type, triggered_by, policy_snapshot) VALUES (#{validationMonth}, #{runNo}, #{runType}, #{triggeredBy}, COALESCE(#{policySnapshotJson}, '{}')::jsonb)
mapper.select:
SELECT vr.validation_run_id AS validationRunId, vr.validation_month AS validationMonth, vr.run_no AS runNo, vr.run_type AS runType, vr.status, vr.current_step AS currentStep, triggered.login_id AS triggeredBy, vr.started_at AS startedAt, vr.completed_at AS completedAt, finalized.login_id AS finalizedBy, vr.finalized_at AS finalizedAt, vr.failure_message AS failureMessage FROM fgc.validation_run vr LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user triggered ON triggered.user_id = vr.triggered_by LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user finalized ON finalized.user_id = vr.finalized_by
ORDER BY vr.validation_month DESC, vr.run_no DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE fgc.validation_run SET status = 'RUNNING', current_step = 1, started_at = now() WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE fgc.validation_run SET status = 'COMPLETED', current_step = 8, completed_at = now() WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
